title: James–Stein Estimation of Structural Equation Models With Latent Variables: A Case Study With lavaan
description: Code, simulation results, and manuscript source for the article "James–Stein Estimation of Structural Equation Models With Latent Variables: A Case Study With lavaan" by Felipe Fontana Vieira and Yves Rosseel, submitted to the Journal of Reproducible Statistics. The repository contains the R scripts for the Monte Carlo simulation and the performance measures, the saved results, the Quarto source of the manuscript, and a pinned computational environment (Nix via the rix package, with a Dockerfile) to reproduce the simulation study and render the article. The code is licensed under the MIT License. The manuscript, figures, and other non-code content are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
